meta.title: Scenario engine — provenance-stamped, refreshed weekly
meta.label: Scenarios are a DATA layer, not hardcoded UI. LIVE scenarios carry MEASURED current driver values and refresh weekly with their source layers; STRESS scenarios are clearly-labelled stated tests (not forecasts). Each card shows its vintage.
meta.refresh: Weekly via .github/workflows/data-scenarios.yml (rebuild + auto-merge on a green determinism gate; draft PR on a red gate).

scenarios.title: Crop-price picture — current
scenarios.headline: Crop prices are up YoY (rice +19%, rubber +25%, palm +13%), lifting farm-household income most in South (+2.8% book income) and least in Central&BKK.
scenarios.provenance: MEASURED — World Bank Pink Sheet commodity board × NSO SES income (via build_income_impact.py first-order pass-through).

scenarios.title: Drought — firing
scenarios.headline: 28 of 76 crop provinces sit in OAE SPEI drought (SPEI ≤ −0.5), amplifying agri-household stress where the book is farm-heavy.
scenarios.provenance: MEASURED — OAE SPEI severe/extreme district census (crop_stress.json).

scenarios.title: Rival promo pressure
scenarios.headline: 24 live rival promotions tracked; our own app trails the best rival on rating — sustained acquisition/retention pressure on margin.
scenarios.provenance: MEASURED — rival own-site promo pull + Google Play ratings (rival_pulse.json).

scenarios.title: Diesel spike +15%
scenarios.headline: STATED STRESS: a +15% diesel move squeezes transport/haulage and pickup-owner margins (fuel is a direct cost line); salaried incomes unaffected.
scenarios.provenance: STATED STRESS (not a forecast) — magnitude chosen to rank exposure; passes through the income engine's documented fuel coefficients.

scenarios.title: Rubber/palm correction -20%
scenarios.headline: STATED STRESS: a -20% reversal in rubber & palm would cut South/East farm income, the mirror of today's tailwind.
scenarios.provenance: STATED STRESS (not a forecast) — downside mirror of the measured tailwind.

scenarios.title: Rice reversal -15%
scenarios.headline: STATED STRESS: a -15% rice-price reversal would pressure Isan/North/Central farm income — the region-1 (Isan) book is most rice-exposed.
